enchantment.somethingsenchanting.lifeste: Heals base on your weapon's damage ang attack speed, 3s cooldowns after 3(+1/lv) heal time
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.ensnare: Immobilizes targets for 2 seconds when hit by Trident or Thrown Weapon.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.telepat: Automatically places mined blocks and mob drops into your inventory.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.echo_st: Creates an invisible blade that deals additional damage 1 second after striking an enemy. Cooldown: 1 second.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.double_: Allows you to perform a second jump while mid-air.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.berserk: When taking damage drops your health below 3 hearts, your armor erupts, knocking enemies back and granting Absorption, Strength II and Resistance III for 5 seconds. This immense power consumes 10% of the armor's current durability. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.slide_t: While sprinting, press Sneak to slide rapidly forward. Enemies hit by the slide take 4 damage (+1 per level), are knocked airborne, and suffer Slowness III for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 3 seconds.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.splinte: Arrows fired stick to the target. Upon death, all stuck arrows explode outward, dealing damage and applying their original potion effects. Ricocheting arrows will not bounce a second time.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.earth_s: Performing a jump attack (Critical Hit) slams the weapon into the ground, creating a shockwave in a 2-block radius. Nearby enemies take 25% of the original damage per level, are knocked back, and suffer Slowness V for 2 seconds. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.aegis_a: Bash enemies with your shield to send them flying into others as living projectiles, dealing 3 damage per level. While blocking, press Sneak to perform a devastating forward charge, knocking enemies airborne and dealing heavy damage.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.wake_ri: Increases the speed of any boat you drive by ~20% per level.
enchantment.somethingsenchanting.triple_: Mines a 3x3 area of blocks. Sneak to mine a single block.
